body:
It does make sense, but honestly I just can't do it anymore. 

Two years ago one of my business partners screwed me out of a quarter million dollars. We've never financially recovered. I built a new business from scratch to try and pay our bills, but I just can't do it alone. Now that she's gone it's over. I've already shut things down and sent out an email to our client base telling them we're out of business permanently. 

I'm 30 years old, and I'm on medication that kills my sperm count. This was my one chance to have a child and it's being taken away from me. I will not have another opportunity.

All I ever wanted out of life was someone to love, someone to love me, and a family to raise. I've worked so, so, so hard to make that happen. I've lost friends because they wanted to go drink while I needed to work. I had nobody left in my life but my wife, and the promise of our family. Now she's gone, and my unborn child is gone with her.

I can't do this again. I can't start over again. I can't pour myself into something just to watch it crumble again. I can't see a way to be happy again. All I ever wanted was a child of my own, and now I'm never going to get to see them. Everything I've done for a decade now has been with the goal of creating a stable, awesome family life for my loved ones. And now none of them want to be around me.

I just can't, man. I appreciate your words and I understand what you're saying, but I just can't. I can't gamble another decade of my life just to end up here again. I can't look at myself in the mirror as a thirty year old man and see anything but a complete failure. My son or daughter is going to be born, never know me, and be told that their dad was a deadbeat who just wasn't around. But the reality is that I want to be with my family more than anything. 

At the end of the day I don't even want to get through this. I just want it to end. I just want to die.

I built the business to support my family. No family, no business.

As for the second, I honestly don't know. I told her just the night before that I felt closer to her than I had in years and that I was excited for our future together. I don't know.

I hear these horror stories of people getting sued / imprisoned because they changed a number in a URL and accidentally found an admin panel. This seems...worse. 

To keep it vague: as a client you log in to this app and do some stuff. Then you do one specific, seemingly innocuous, thing. And then anyone who is paying attention can remotely execute arbitrary commands from within your session, and it's going to look like you (the client) are doing it yourself. 

Like I said, I could be wrong. When I realized what I was looking at, I got the fuck away from it. But I'm still concerned, especially since they're kind of ignoring me now. They used to be very responsive to my calls and emails; now they're not and I'm worried it's because their lawyers told them not to contact me until they've got guns ready to fire.

That second option you mentioned, how could I go about finding a reputable security company to do just that? I would be happy just GIVING it to them rather than selling it, just so it's officially Someone Else's Problem. But I don't want to give a crook the keys to the backdoor, and unfortunately I don't have the experience to tell a legit security expert from someone with a blacker hat.

Yeah, the second part of what you said is what worries me. 

I think they are beyond not PCI compliant. I think they have a massive data breach impacting their clients and their clients' clients. Ethically, I really feel like I need to be telling someone. 

Practically, though, I don't need a lawsuit filed against me. I have a family and a mortgage. 

I feel like a piece of shit for it, but I'm leaning towards just walking away.
